location.exact_old_phrase: Known proper rigid+uniform scale transform through the same AABB normalization and registration reports remaining errors rather than assuming invariance.

cause: This controls bullet was inherited unchanged from v1 maxside-AABB experiment when the separate v2 protocol introduced area-weighted surface centroid/RMS-radius normalization. It is a wording remnant, not the executed v2 algorithm.

clarification.corrected_description: Known proper rigid+positive uniform-scale transform is tested through exact triangle-area-weighted surface-centroid and RMS-surface-radius normalization. Analytic covariance and corresponding normalized-point inverse rotation are checked first, then both known-same-shape holdout ICP gates must pass before evaluating raw reconstructions.
clarification.authoritative_v2_normalization_rule: Exact triangle-area-weighted surface centroid mu and RMS radius r; normalize x to (x-mu)/r once before rigid ICP.
clarification.calibration_gate: CD_mean_sq <= 1.5 * independent-seed-reference-floor + 1e-5, checked for cube and chair before raw reconstruction evaluation. This is a synthetic measurement calibration gate, not a real-user quality criterion.
clarification.units: v2 RMS-surface-radius1; v1 maxside1 values are not before/after quality-improvement values.

scope_limits: No frozen protocol, summary, manifest, source, numeric result or image is rewritten.
No thresholds, calibration criteria, measured values or interpretation scope are changed.
No product/MD/registry/context mutation, new model inference or provider call.
